acceptance_gate: Code and retained evidence are provisional until a separate documentation change amends the exact HSP-20 and security-boundary contract and a fresh reviewer accepts that amendment.

HSP-08.fixture: Verified persisted journal bytes with canonical filters, exact dependency reconstruction, fixed-HWM cursor restart, append-stable linear provenance commitments, disposable SQLite, and relocated identity.
HSP-08.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_hsp08_durable_query.py
expected_assertions: canonical filters use one verified persisted journal snapshot in chronological order
Journal, ServiceIdentity, QueryRequest, PrincipalScope, and every nested model are exact reconstructed inputs before durable hooks
malformed cursors reject before provenance work and authenticated wrong-context or old-context recovery is linear
lane, topic, and entity fail with filter_not_available before evaluation
deleted or corrupt SQLite is neither opened nor rebuilt
cursor restart preserves its original high-watermark and persists no read state
deferred: durable lane, topic, and entity provenance
daemon, Unix-socket API, CLI, streaming, and consumer integration

HSP-20.fixture: Exact-LF persisted journal triplet plus one private generation/keyring identity using exact-FD publication and immutable marker-bound recovery under process death, fork, lock, path-race, restart, and relocation matrices.
HSP-20.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_hsp20_durable_state.py
expected_assertions: snapshot holds one journal lock and never mixes append state
request verification never repairs chain or head while explicit reconcile repairs only provable suffix loss
forged, divergent, out-of-range, CRLF, partial, or noncanonical journal truth fails with no bytes changed
the canonical persisted identity field is generation
new identity bytes originate in a fsynced validated O_TMPFILE and every witness is linked from its held FD without overwrite
AT_EMPTY_PATH falls back only through a held /proc/self/fd dirfd and a numeric relative entry with AT_SYMLINK_FOLLOW
marker-bound RENAME_EXCHANGE recovery preserves displaced bytes and never adopts prepublication witnesses
forked children reject inherited operations before the inherited mutex and cannot unlock the parent
generation and complete cursor keyring survive restart and clean relocation without absolute-path identity
deferred: the separately reviewed VISION and security-boundary amendment required before claim acceptance
transport readiness and daemon recovery loop
privileged deployment and physical power-loss certification
same-UID pathname swaps restored before final validation

HSP-21.fixture: Machine-checked Slice 3A artifact map, source digests, JSON reports, and retained focused/compatibility JUnit results.
HSP-21.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_slice3a_evidence.py
expected_assertions: every changed Slice 3A implementation, regression, and proof artifact maps to exactly one partial or regression-only HSP claim
all required reports and both zero-failure JUnit files are retained and parseable
source digests bind the proof bundle to the reviewed code and tests
the bundle labels HSP-20 and HSP-21 acceptance provisional pending the separate contract amendment
HSP-03 and HSP-09 are explicitly unclaimed
deferred: whole 22-row completion manifest and global acceptance checker
canonical documentation amendment and fresh claim review

portable_boundary.platform: Linux with O_TMPFILE, linkat, procfs fallback, renameat2 RENAME_NOREPLACE, flock, and RENAME_EXCHANGE
portable_boundary.cooperation: same-UID processes are assumed cooperative after final held/visible validation
explicit_exclusions: same-UID swap restored to the same inode before final validation
platforms without the required Linux atomic namespace primitives
